message.reasoning:
With 1e6 photons taking 5.5s, I can scale up to 2e7 in about 2 minutes, which is reasonable. Checking the normalized fluence values, the scattered contribution comes out to 0.397 and the primary to 0.614, which matches expectations.

The scatter-to-primary ratio of about 0.65 seems physically reasonable — for 2 MeV beams at 10 cm depth, dose scatter fractions of 0.3-0.4 are typical, so this is in a plausible range. I also want to double check the interaction counting: primary interactions per photon should be track-length times attenuation coefficient, which checks out at 156 interactions per million photons.

I'll plan to run the full 2e7 photon simulation as a batch of smaller runs (maybe 20 batches of 1e6 with different seeds) in a single call, keeping total runtime around 2 minutes and memory manageable.
